description: One pattern page (/patterns/{pattern}.md): definition, aliases, when it is hypothesised to fit, failure modes, sources and whether this deployment can execute it. Adds a second item with a one-time use ticket and a one-line instruction when this selected read is eligible; `report_outcome` returns useful indexed follow-up after redemption.
